settings.markdown: Welcome to the City of Quinte West Open GIS Data Platform!

This is the City's public platform for exploring and downloading open Geographic Information Systems (GIS) data. GIS is the input, storage, manipulation, analysis, reporting, and output of digital spatial data using computers, mobile devices, and peripherals.
For maps and apps, please go to the City's GIS site Quinte West Maps

Open GIS Data Sets

Open data is free, and available to everyone in one or more open and accessible formats. Data that contains personal identifying information, or information that may pose as a security or confidentiality concern, will not be released as open data. The data is provided under the City of Quinte West Open Data Licence 1.0 which is based on version 1.0 of the Open Government Licence – Ontario, adapted for municipal use and jurisdiction. By using the open data on this site, you are agreeing to the City of Quinte West Open Data Terms of Use.
